sections.shortTitle: The Sindh Services Tribunals Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE SINDH SERVICES TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
THE SINDH SERVICES TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
SINDH ACT NO. X OF 2014
AN
ACT
KARACHI, THE 20TH
MARCH, 2014.
NO.PAS/Legis-B-04/2014-The
Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Bill, 2014 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
28th February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 19th March, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh to amend the Sindh Service
Tribunals Act,1973.
Preamble.- WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Service Tribunals Act,1973, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.-- (1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Service Tribunals
(Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 7th August, 2013.

Amendment of section 3 of Sind Act No.XV of 1973

THE SINDH SERVICES TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
THE SINDH SERVICES TRIBUNALS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
SINDH ACT NO. X OF 2014
AN
ACT
KARACHI, THE 20TH
MARCH, 2014.
NO.PAS/Legis-B-04/2014-The
Sindh Service Tribunals (Amendment) Bill, 2014 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
28th February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 19th March, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh to amend the Sindh Service
Tribunals Act,1973.
Preamble.- WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Service Tribunals Act,1973, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 3 of
Sind Act No.XV of 1973.-- In the Sindh
Service Tribunals Act, 1973, in section 3, for sub-sections (3) and (4), the
following shall be substituted:-
(3) A Tribunal shall consist of a Chairman
and two Members, who shall be appointed by Government in consultation with the
Chief Justice, High Court of Sindh, for a period not
more than three years for one time only.
(4)
(i) A person who has
been or is qualified to be a Judge of the High Court, shall be eligible for
appointment as Chairman.
(ii) two
members, one of whom shall be appointed from amongst the practicing Advocates
having seven years experience of High Court and another shall be appointed from
amongst the sitting civil servants in BS-20, preferably having legal
background, for a period of not more than three years for one time only or till
the date of his superannuation, whichever is earlier.
